intro: An action is a method of a regular service in your extension. With the default `Configuration/Services.yaml` of an extension, TYPO3 finds the attribute automatically, and you register nothing.

steps.title: Attribute
steps.text: Mark a public method with `#[AsAction]`, set its name and select a scope that exists, for example `content:read`.

steps.title: Typed input and output
steps.text: Typed parameters and an exact PHPDoc return type define the JSON Schema. TYPO3 validates the values and converts them.

steps.title: Declared errors
steps.text: Throw `NotFoundError` or `PermissionDeniedError` and declare each one with `@throws`.

results_intro: Without more code, TYPO3 makes both methods available in these channels:

results.value: Both operations with parameters, response schemas and the documented `404`
`fetch_my_extension_news_latest` and `fetch_my_extension_news_by_uid`, for every client with the scope `content:read`
TYPO3 makes sure that `limit` is an integer and that the results match the declared array shapes

scope.title: Custom scopes
scope.text: The scopes of TYPO3 cover most cases. If an administrator must grant access to your actions separately, register a scope and reference its class in `scopes`.
